desc:
👍👍 Thumbs up the game for more updates and rewards!

**CRIME CITY RP**

Welcome to Crime City — Can you survive the night?

Explore an open-world city with realistic character meshes!

Work a normal job, earn money, rob stores, steal valuables, sell and pawn loot, or buy weapons. Shoot from cars, blow up vehicles, upgrade to better cars or buy your own helicopter! Fight other players, build alliances, start your own gang, and take over the streets!

Enforce the law as a Police Officer, join specialized units like SWAT or FBI, save lives as a Paramedic, or earn money driving players around as a Taxi Driver.

Play your way — live a peaceful life, work jobs, and explore the city with PvP protection, or jump into the action and fight other players.

⚠️ **Warning:** You drop your inventory when you die. Store your valuables somewhere safe!

💻 PC • Mobile • Xbox • PlayStation

🎤 Voice Chat Supported
